title: Novelty Score
description: DISCOVER-stage artifact. Output of novelty-scorer. Assigns a novelty score and a feasibility signal to every classified gap — SCORE-ONLY, never a cut or verdict. An empty scores array is allowed (zero gaps in). derived_from MAY be empty: a genuinely zero-signal gap is novelty 0.0 and MUST stay representable (forcing derived_from non-empty would make the schema a de-facto novelty cut, which is forbidden). Every present score still carries a non-blank evidence_ref[] (anti-slop). No pass/verdict/include/cut/selected field exists: novelty is advisory, never a gate.

scores.description: One score entry per input gap. Every gap receives a score; none are dropped or filtered.

gap_id.description: The gap_id this score corresponds to (links to gap_classification output).

novelty.description: Novelty score in [0, 1]. Higher = more novel relative to the surveyed landscape. ADVISORY ONLY — never a gate or cut. A zero-signal gap is legitimately 0.0.

feasibility_signal.description: Feasibility signal in [0, 1]. Derived deterministically from signal presence; advisory, not a gate.

derived_from.description: The named provenance signals aggregated to produce this score, e.g. future_work, white_space_present, contrarian_angle. MAY be empty (a zero-signal gap is novelty 0.0); when present each item must be non-blank (no fabricated empty-string slop).

evidence_ref.description: Evidence pointers (gap_ids / source_refs) grounding this score (anti-slop). At least one required; each must be non-blank.
